## Appearance

Charlie Sloane is characterized by his prominent, goggle eyes.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P23](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0023)_

## Personality

Charlie Sloane harbors ambitions to pursue a career in politics. His ultimate goal is to become a member of Parliament.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)_

## History

Charlie Sloane previously told his mother that [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) was the smartest girl in school and fought [Moody Spurgeon MacPherson](../character/moody-spurgeon-macpherson.md) after Moody claimed [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) put on airs regarding her recitations. He also once dared Arty Gillis to jump over an old well. Later, Charlie was selected as one of the advanced students invited to join Miss Stacy's special class to prepare for the Queen's entrance examination.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong P1](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P2](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P16](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), +1 more_

## Relationships

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlie-sloane--gilbert-blythe.md)

Charlie Sloane and [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) are considered rivals in competing for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's good graces. Outside of this presumed rivalry, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) is an intense academic rival of [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), though [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) secretly regrets their feud after a past falling-out during their school days.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P34](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0034), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), +9 more_

- presumed Rival of — rivals in the good graces of Anne Shirley (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P0](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0000)</sub>
